About the show

Theatre 118 reopens with our highly popular new material night. Every month, a range of acts perform brand new play extracts, stand-up, poetry, music and pretty much any other kind of live performance you can imagine.

Concessions at Theatre 118

Theatre 118 runs Pay What You Can on every show: the standard price is a suggestion, and nobody is turned away for paying less. There is a £1.50 booking fee per order.

No venue-wide concession scheme is published. Any reduction for this show will be on the booking page.

Open to everyone
